thread:
alice: starting a deploy for model-routing v3. this one flips the cost-aware fallback logic. planning a soft-open feature flag instead of full cutover to watch latency and error behavior
ben: +1. what's the plan for % ramp and guardrails?
alice: thinking 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% over ~2h windows. short holds at each step (10m) to validate metrics before proceeding.
carla: watch p99 latency, request error rate, and kvcache hit ratio. add a span for tail latency by seq len. if p99 increases > 30% from baseline, hold and investigate.
dave: add circuit backpressure: if error rate > 0.5% OR p99 > baseline *1.3 for 2 consecutive windows, auto-drain to previous flag state. we should also be able to manually cut to 0% quickly.
alice: deploy-bot, can you start the soft-open with those checkpoints and gate automations? here is the ff config i'm going to use:
```
flag: model_routing_v3
stages:
  - pct: 5
    hold: 600
  - pct: 20
    hold: 1200
  - pct: 50
    hold: 3600
  - pct: 100
    hold: 0
guards:
  p99_multiplier: 1.3
  error_rate_pct: 0.5
  auto_drain: true
```
ben: looks good, pls pin canary model version to v3-202603 and keep fallback pinned to v2 for at least 24h. also add a QA evaluation traffic slice (internal users) at 2% before the 5% public slice.
carla: +1 on the QA slice. I'll add synthetic prompt checks and quality evals in the first 10m window. set up a fail-fast alert to #eng-oncall if quality drops below threshold.
dave: rollback runbook reminder: `deploy-bot rollback-flags model_routing_v3 --to 0` and `traffic-control set-slice --name default --pct 100 --model v2-locked`. Keep runbook pinned in the thread.
alice: noted. also adding a brief release note to product: "soft-open model routing v3 behind FF; progressive ramp with automated backpressure and manual holdpoints."
ben: one more: throttle ingress if we see downstream GPU saturation, we should cap concurrency at current baseline + 20%. can infra add a dashboard tile for GPU queue length? @carla can you coordinate?
carla: will do. I'll add dashboard and an automated PagerDuty trigger for sustained GPU-queue > 10 for 3min.
deploy-bot: [deploy started] feature flag model_routing_v3 set to 2% (QA slice) by alice at 2062345678. next automated step at 2062346278 unless gate condition triggers hold.
alice: thanks, everyone. I'll monitor the first 15m and post updates. if anyone wants immediate abort, react with :no_entry_sign: here or ping me DMs.
ben: ping if we need to pin to canary-only.
dave: I'll be on standby for rollback ops.
carla: initial metrics look OK after 6m: p50/p90 unchanged, p99 +8%. continuing to watch.
alice: update after 12m: QA slice passed evals, moving to 5% public in 2m.
deploy-bot: [progress] feature flag model_routing_v3 increased to 5% at 2062345780 by deploy automation. next hold until 2062346380.
carla: starting synthetic regression suite now. will report failures inline.
ben: lgtm, thanks all.
carla: regression suite green at 2062345799. no quality regressions observed.
alice: proceeding with 20% plan in next window unless anyone objects. will log final notes to release notes doc after full cutover.
